digitalCards.title: Personal ID Card (Digital NFC)
digitalCards.desc: A card the size of a Visa or ID card, allowing you to add all your personal and professional data. The card comes plain so you can print your company design or brand logo on it.
digitalCards.premiumDesc: Credit card sized NFC card. Add your full personal & professional data. Comes plain for custom print.

autoTap.title: Auto Tap Stickers
autoTap.desc: Waterproof NFC stickers for your car. Share your profile with a tap on the window.
autoTap.windowNotice: Standard rear side window size: 35cm. Custom sizes available.

businessTap.title: Restaurants & Cafes
businessTap.desc: Place your full menu on every table with one tap, create a custom sticker for easy Wi-Fi password access, or an InstaPay sticker for instant smart payments, and more tailored services for your comfort and your customers' convenience.
businessTap.marketing: Place your full menu on every table with one tap, create a custom sticker that opens your Wi-Fi password directly, or an InstaPay sticker for instant payment transfers.
businessTap.servicesDesc: Everything you need to modernize your establishment
